subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector work land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue covers multiple companion apps and session routing affects user state, so automation should not choose platform scope or permanent UX on its own.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk target selection with existing gateway agents and sessions, then evaluate iOS/macOS follow-up separately.

options.title: Shared companion-app policy
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define common Talk/Voice selection semantics for Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Defer voice target selection
options.body: Keep default-session Talk routing for now and revisit when the broader voice roadmap is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk target selection with existing gateway agents and sessions, then evaluate iOS/macOS follow-up separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion already uses this handle to scope the landed TTS work and the remaining Talk/Voice selection gap.
